svg.text: USB-C options for the USB board (component side)
Plug a Mini-USB to USB-C adapter
Swap the Mini-B socket for a USB-C
A new board with the same outline,
Option B wiring: Mini-B socket pin to USB-C pad
USB-C pins (A and B sides joined)
CC pins (USB-C side): each through 5.1 kΩ to GND
Both resistors are needed so USB-C chargers supply 5 V. Check which pad is which on your socket before soldering.
